question: To propagate caste equality, ___________ founded the Satyashodhak Samaj.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jyotiba Phule.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To propagate caste equality, **Jyotiba Phule founded the Satyashodhak Samaj**.
 
• It was founded in **Pune, Maharashtra on 24 September 1873**.
 
• They advocated for the empowerment of Dalits in Maharashtra, through education and greater political and social access.
